findings: Full November Wallets overview preserves saved credential/stored balance, typical wallet authentication and credential/token handoff, mobile/web examples and recurring caveats. May MoMo/GCash waitlist is now a linked email request path for Vietnam and Philippines one-time/recurring preview interest. Submission doesn't establish acceptance, account enablement or implementation (old raw lines 15-17; new raw lines 16-30). Source line 19 should state the documented waitlist rather than broad 'not yet available'.

Both matrices present table-specific support, not product eligibility proof. Keep PayPay Connect invite, Apple Pay embedded Safari/iOS constraints, Link Payment Element Brazil/India and the distinct send_invoice and setup_future_usage footnotes. November adds 18th product row TWINT (old raw lines 68-88; new raw lines 79-100) and Samsung Pay and TWINT API rows (old raw lines 94-113; new raw lines 106-127). TWINT details are separately scoped to its method page and authorized mandates (raw/stripe-payments-twint-2026-11-07.md lines 188-198 and 212-236).

Root index line 7 routes to Stripe index lines 384-385 and Wallets concept line 385 links the source. Add source-to-Wallets route and retain separately dated method, capability, preview and migration references.

The November Wallets Alipay row, interpreted under header line 79, labels Mobile Payment Element Supported (new raw lines 79-81). The same-date method profile explains that its unsupported In-app payments row refers to Mobile Payment Element (PaymentSheet) and separately describes accepting through custom iOS, Android and React Native (raw/stripe-payments-alipay-2026-11-07.md lines 144-164). Preserve this modality discrepancy separately from one-time invoice support and invite-only recurring (profile lines 166-170).

The November Wallets stablecoin row lists Subscriptions Invite only, Customer Portal Supported, SetupIntents and setup_future_usage Invite only, and manual capture Unsupported (new raw lines 79, 95, 106 and 122). The same-date cross-method dedicated stablecoin rows instead list Subscriptions and Customer Portal Private preview, Invoicing Supported with the send_invoice subscription footnote, SetupIntents and setup_future_usage Private preview, and manual capture Supported (raw/stripe-payments-payment-methods-payment-method-support-2026-11-07.md lines 169-173 and 305-307). The direct method overview says manual capture unsupported and describes Billing support for invoices and subscriptions (raw/stripe-payments-stablecoin-payments-2026-11-07.md lines 47-49 and 157-159). Preserve all three scopes when qualifying source line 35 and Wallets concept line 46 without implying universal support, account access or actual recurring/capture behavior.

The November Wallets hub additionally marks Customer Portal Unsupported for Satispay alongside Subscriptions and Invoicing (new raw lines 79 and 94). The same-date Satispay method profile marks Customer Portal Supported together with Billing and Invoicing (raw/stripe-payments-satispay-2026-11-07.md lines 194-198). Preserve the discrepancy along with the profile's separate saving and recurring claims.

historical_claims_to_preserve: May 7, 2026 Wallets hub product table comprised 17 rows and documented Samsung Pay Terminal only, MB WAY Mobile Payment Element/Subscriptions/Invoicing unsupported, Alipay invoice invite-only, WeChat Pay online-only Terminal cell, and India IP non-display for Apple Pay/Google Pay (old raw lines 68-88).

May API list, including `crypto` SetupIntent/setup_future_usage invite only and no manual capture, and retained November product and API footnotes (old raw lines 94-113 and new raw lines 100, 106-127).
conflicts: Samsung Pay: old product row Terminal-only and no API row (old raw lines 68-88, 94-111); November adds Checkout except subscription/setup and a `samsung_pay` PaymentIntents/redirect row, with Terminal retained (new raw lines 93, 100, 120, 127). WeChat Pay: November hub flips redirect to Yes, Terminal to supported except Japan, subscriptions from Supported to Private preview (send_invoice footnote), and SetupIntents/setup_future_usage to Private preview (old raw lines 86-88, 111; new raw lines 98-100, 125-127). Separate November method page puts recurring off-session in private preview but standard API row marks SetupIntents, future usage and off-session unsupported. It reports Terminal not Japan/manual setup, desktop QR stays open and supported native mobile returns to app (raw/stripe-payments-wechat-pay-2026-11-07.md lines 118-122, 152-199). Keep previews, standard baseline and modality distinct. Wallets concept lines 32 and 361-372 currently have flat older labels.

MB WAY: November hub adds Mobile Payment Element, Subscriptions and Invoicing (last two send_invoice) and keeps Express Checkout Element supported (old raw line 77; new raw lines 88, 100, 115). The same-date method overview marks Express Checkout Element unsupported and separately lists In-app payments, distinguishes hosted send_invoice one-by-one from automatic recurring, and limits Checkout to one-time only (raw/stripe-payments-mb-way-2026-11-07.md lines 104-130 and 143-147). Do not silently resolve Express Checkout Element or equate a manually paid invoice with a saved off-session mandate.

Alipay: hub changes Invoicing invite-only to Supported and redirects No to Yes while Subscriptions invite-only remains (old raw lines 70 and 96; new raw lines 81 and 108). Separate November method overview distinguishes one-time Checkout/Hosted Invoice Page from invite-only recurring with individual Alipay approval (raw/stripe-payments-alipay-2026-11-07.md lines 144-170); don't infer general recurring access or need to apply for ordinary invoices. Source line 29 is historical May.

Preserve the conflicting dated evidence and avoid inferring general access from an absent row or granting every Billing path from the method-level label.

source_assessments.reason: This is a full recapture with matrix and waitlist changes that alter which integration paths readers would select.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/wallets, the November 7, 2026 overview describes wallet funding by saved tokenized credentials or stored balances. The buyer typically authenticates with the wallet, which hands payment data or a token to the merchant or processor, and the illustrative mobile/web flow shows a completion notification. Merchants should check device, country, product, future-use and dunning conditions before enabling a wallet. The MoMo/GCash email form requests preview access, without proving approval or a payment state (new raw lines 9-47 and 49-73). May already described the wallet flow and waitlist, but the November matrices add TWINT and broaden documented Samsung Pay checkout/redirect routes, change Alipay invoicing and redirect, MB WAY in-app-related and send_invoice product cells, WeChat Pay Terminal/redirect and private-preview setup flags, and India's Google Pay account qualification (old raw lines 8-34 and 68-113; new raw lines 79-127). source-stripe-wallets.md retains the older 17-method product matrix and Terminal-only Samsung Pay; it needs November evidence and scope qualifiers. A matrix flag alone does not establish eligibility, recurring mandate creation or payment completion.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/wallets, November's changed wallet matrix and waitlist request are substantive, while heading syntax, separators and illustration URLs mainly change presentation (old raw lines 15-17, 36-62 and 68-113; new raw lines 16-30, 49-73 and 79-127). Preserve dated May Samsung Pay Terminal-only and November Checkout excluding setup/subscription and samsung_pay PaymentIntents/redirect. Preserve old India IP wording versus November Google Pay account restriction and Apple's omitted marker. WeChat Pay Terminal excludes Japan, preview recurring and standard capabilities stay scoped, and desktop QR does not imply a browser redirect. MB WAY's send_invoice does not mean automatic recurrence, its hub Express Checkout Element cell conflicts with the dedicated method page, and Satispay's hub product cells and missing API row do not supersede the separate November method page. Alipay's one-time Invoicing and invite-only recurring are distinct. Keep these qualifications in source-stripe-wallets.md with both factual raws and the existing root index line 7, Stripe index lines 384-385 and Wallets concept line 385. Add a reciprocal source link.
